rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice for attacking, glaring, or acting viciously.

example.english: They viciously berated the child until he cried.
example.traditional: 佢惡狠狠咁鬧到個細路喊晒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ok3 han2 han2 gam3 naau6 dou3 go3 sai3 lou6 haam3 saai3

rows.note: Use this when the vicious action is forceful or violent rather than specifically malicious.

example.english: They viciously punched their opponent in the face.
example.traditional: 佢狠狠咁一拳打中對手個面。
example.jyutping: keoi5 han2 han2 gam3 jat1 kyun4 daa2 zung3 deoi3 sau2 go3 min6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on cruelty toward someone or something.

example.english: That abuser treated the dog viciously.
example.traditional: 嗰個虐待狂殘忍咁對待隻狗。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 joek6 doi6 kong4 caan4 jan2 gam3 deoi3 doi6 zek3 gau2
